name: QR Code Reader
description: Turn the camera into a hands-free scanner: decode one or many QR codes in view at once, read the payload of each, and stream every result to your automations — asset check-in, access gates, kiosk workflows and inventory, no handheld scanner required.
description_zh: 把摄像头变成免手持扫码枪：一次识别画面中的单个或多个二维码，读出各自内容并把结果实时推送给自动化流程——资产登记、门禁核验、自助终端和库存盘点，无需手持扫码设备。
author: Seeed Studio
